text:
toni: kicking off config-only rollout: batch_window_ms 30->10, per_tenant_qps 25->15, routing=cost-aware. Canary 2% for 20m. deploy-bot queued.
deploy-bot: Canary cfg-canary-1745001111 started — weight=2%, batch_window_ms=10, per_tenant_qps=15, pinned_model=v2.3.1. health checks enabled.
ravi: ack. I'll watch p50/p95, queue depth, and kvcache hit rate.
ops-oncall: baseline alerts set: p95>350ms for 5m -> warn; p95>500ms for 3m -> recommend rollback.
(8m later)
ravi: noticed p95 spike to ~520ms on two canary hosts, correlated with kvcache miss surge.
lee: can we reduce weight or bump batch_window for canary? small batches might be thrashing cache.
toni: pause ramp. reduce canary weight -> 0.5%, set batch_window_ms -> 20 for canary nodes only. Deploy-bot apply.
deploy-bot: Updating canary: weight=0.5% ... done; batch_window_ms=20 ... done. pinned_model unchanged.
ops-oncall: dashboards show p95 falling back under 300ms on canary nodes.
ravi: performing targeted fallback for tenants with tail>450ms to v2.2.8 (more conservative cache behavior). Command run: `/deploy fallback --canary cfg-canary-1745001111 --from v2.3.1 --to v2.2.8 --selector "tail>450ms"`
lee: nice surgical fallback. please log tenant ids to ticket.
toni: created TKT-24567: "canary small-batch kvcache churn 1 - follow-up: cache warming and eviction tuning" assigned to eng-runtime.
(15m later)
ravi: canary p95 stable ~240ms, fallback affected ~0.8% traffic. quality check looks fine.
toni: plan: hold 0.5% for 20m, then step to 3% -> 10% over 1.5h if stable. rollback criteria unchanged. adding blameless note to release notes.
ops-oncall: monitoring active. will escalate if p95 trends up.
lee: leaving follow-up items in TKT-24567: tenant-specific batching heuristics, simulate low batch_window load in staging.
toni: thanks all. will close when 10% hold completes. :white_check_mark:
